# Which CI work a changed file needs (issue #1258).
#
# tools/ci_classes.py reads this file. Its header says what the three kinds of
# line mean. tools/check_ci_classes.py holds the file to the repository: every
# tracked file has a class, a class selects the jobs that read its files, and
# the backend classes follow the #include graph.
#
# The first `path` line that matches a file gives its classes, so a specific
# line goes before a general one.
#
# Gates are the units of CI work that a job or a group of steps carries:
#   placement      the document-placement check. Always runs.
#   tables         the pure-Python checks of the spec tables and the probe index
#   format         clang-format
#   pi             the pi extension jobs
#   native-build   the release build of loxpp, which compiles every backend
#   native-unit    the debug build and `ctest -L`, for the labels of the class.
#                  A class with labels runs it. `native-unit` is not listed.
#   native-checks  the example, probe and bootstrap steps on the native VM
#   probes         the steps of the native, JVM, QBE and cross jobs that run the
#                  probes, the examples or a differential through a harness tool.
#                  A job runs for its own gate or for this one, and its other
#                  steps test their own gate.
#   gc             the steps that run each collector: the suites with `incremental`,
#                  the comparison of the collectors, the pause gate and the Redis
#                  load. A change of the heap or of the collector selects them.
#   jvm            the JVM backend job
#   qbe            the QBE backend job
#   cross          the checks that compare native with the bootstrap interpreter
#   codecrafters   the codecrafters jobs
#   tree-sitter, lsp, neovim, vscode, release-static   the job of that name

# --- the CI itself: a change here can break anything, so everything runs
path .github/ci-classes.txt                    ci
path .github/workflows/ci.yml                  ci
path .github/workflows/release.yml             packaging
path .github/workflows/**                      inert
path test/test_labels.txt                      ci
path tools/ci_classes.py                       ci
path tools/check_ci_classes.py                 ci
path tools/check_test_labels.py                ci
path tools/testdata/ci-classify.txt            ci

path .clang-format                             core
path .clang-tidy                               inert
path .pre-commit-config.yaml                   inert

# --- the build. The Dockerfile holds every image stage, so any change runs all.

# --- what each class runs
class ci               gates=all labels=all
class test-source      gates=format tests=CoreSymbolsUnique
class test-support     gates=format,probes labels=all
class core             gates=tables,format,native-build,native-checks,jvm,qbe,cross,codecrafters,lsp,neovim,vscode,release-static labels=all
class shared-backend   gates=format,native-build,jvm,qbe labels=shared-backend
class jvm              gates=format,native-build,jvm,tables labels=jvm
class qbe              gates=format,native-build,qbe labels=qbe
class tooling          gates=format,native-build,lsp,neovim,vscode labels=tooling
# The two tests read the tables of spec/04-semantics.md and spec/05-stdlib.md.
class spec             gates=tables,probes tests=BootstrapErrorKindAudit,BootstrapSuspendCalls
class spec-lib         tests=BootstrapSuspendCalls
class programs         gates=tables,native-checks,jvm,qbe,tree-sitter labels=corpus
class bootstrap        gates=native-checks,jvm,qbe,cross,tree-sitter labels=corpus,bootstrap
class bootstrap-tools  gates=native-checks,jvm,qbe,cross labels=bootstrap
class harness          gates=tables,probes labels=harness,corpus
class lsp-smoke        gates=lsp,release-static
# tools/runner_precondition.py is a module of the tools that start a runner. Each
# test that runs such a tool and has the label core runs by name.
class runner-lib       gates=lsp,release-static,probes,gc labels=bootstrap tests=GcTrace,GcTraceV3,GcCollectorChoice,GcLargeHeap,GcStwCounts,GcStall,GcSweepLinear,GcMinHeap,GcIncremental,GcPauseGate,GcCollectorRuns,GcCollectorDiff,ReplSession
# test/CMakeLists.txt runs RunnerPrecondition, which scans every tools/*.py
# file for one that starts a process, so each of them selects it.
class py-tool          tests=RunnerPrecondition
class spec-tables      gates=tables
class codecrafters     gates=codecrafters
class tree-sitter      gates=tree-sitter,neovim
class nvim             gates=neovim
class vscode           gates=vscode
class bench            labels=bench
# The programs of benchmarks/gc_large_heap/ and their pinned collection counts
# run through the tests that scale them down and compare them, not through the
# benchmark tests.
class gc-large-heap    tests=GcLargeHeap,GcStwCounts
# The contract document holds the table that GcBarrierTable checks.
class gc-barrier-doc   tests=GcBarrierTable
# A change of the heap runs the suites with each collector: the native tests,
# the example corpus, the QBE job, the Redis shards and the pause gate. It
# does not run the JVM and the editor jobs, which the heap does not reach.
class gc-heap          gates=gc,native-build,native-checks,qbe,codecrafters labels=all
# The probes of the incremental collector run through GcIncremental.
class gc-incremental   tests=GcIncremental
class pi               gates=pi
class cross-probe      gates=cross
class packaging        gates=release-static,tables
class docs
class inert

# --- which gates a job of ci.yml belongs to
job changes               gates=placement
job checks                gates=placement
job spec-tables           gates=tables
job format                gates=format
job pi-extensions         gates=pi
job pi-modes              gates=pi
job tree-sitter           gates=tree-sitter
job loxpp-lsp             gates=lsp
job neovim-plugin         gates=neovim
job vscode-extension      gates=vscode
job build-and-test        gates=native-build,native-unit,native-checks,probes,gc
job codecrafters          gates=codecrafters
job redis-shard-plan      gates=codecrafters,gc
job redis-stage-shards    gates=codecrafters,gc
job gc-pause              gates=gc
job managed-toolchains    gates=jvm,probes
job cross-consumer        gates=cross,probes
job qbe-toolchain         gates=qbe,probes
job release-static        gates=release-static

# --- files that a job names, and that a change of them does not need it for
# release-static runs tools/check_examples.py on the static binary. That checks
# the musl build, and an example can fail there only by a musl difference. The
# full run on main finds that, and a static build for each new example costs
# more than it finds.
ignore release-static examples/**
ignore release-static tools/check_examples.py

# --- files that a script names in its text and does not read
# tools/check_ci_classes.py follows one level: the files that a script of a job
# or a test names or imports must select that job or test too. These lines are
# the names that a script holds as text only.
# These tools take the runner on the command line, and their help text names
# the runners that one can pass.
script-ignore tools/diff_runtimes.py tools/loxpp_*.sh
script-ignore tools/diff_runtimes.py tools/jvm_excluded_examples.txt
script-ignore tools/check_print_lines.py tools/loxpp_*.sh
script-ignore tools/check_spec_probes.py tools/loxpp_*.sh
script-ignore tools/check_examples.py tools/jvm_excluded_examples.txt
# These two checks hold a copy of the reserved words of the spec. They do not
# read the spec, so a change of the spec does not change their result.
script-ignore tools/check_nvim_syntax.py spec/01-lexical.md
script-ignore tools/check_textmate_grammar.py spec/01-lexical.md
# These scripts name a spec file in a docstring or a comment. Only
# check_bootstrap_error_kinds.py and spec_tables.py read one.
script-ignore tools/check_bootstrap_map_iteration.py spec/**
script-ignore tools/check_bootstrap_match_arm_break.py spec/**
script-ignore tools/check_bootstrap_park_state.py spec/**
script-ignore tools/check_bootstrap_stack_overflow.py spec/**
script-ignore tools/run_bootstrap_error_kind_causes.py spec/**
script-ignore tools/diff_runtimes.py spec/**
script-ignore tools/check_repl_session.py spec/**
script-ignore tools/check_repl_session.py test/test_repl.cpp
# check_runner_precondition.py scans the files of tools/ and not of its
# subdirectories. It names tools/agent-workflow files in text only.
script-ignore tools/check_runner_precondition.py tools/agent-workflow/**
# The pi mode test names a shell script as the text of a mock command line.
script-ignore tools/test_pi_modes.mjs tools/check_qbe_s8_promotion.sh
